name: Contrary Fusion
desc: Fusion Summon 1 Plant monster from your Extra Deck to your field by using 1 monster from your Deck and 1 monster in your hand/field. You can also banish monsters in your GY as Fusion material. Monsters Fusion Summoned by this card's effect have their ATK and DEF swapped. Also take control of 1 monster your opponent controls.
strings: Fusion Summon, swap ATK/DEF, and take control
